## Problem

What workflow is awkward today? Example: "I dock the laptop but want presets to switch automatically."

## Proposed solution

How would you like it to work?

## Alternatives considered

Other tools or workarounds you tried.

## Additional context

Screenshots or links are welcome. Keep in mind this extension uses display **roles** (builtin, largest, rightmost) and Mission Control **Spaces**, not fixed display indices.
